Math that's out of this world

Space Math turns early math into a trip through space. Little astronauts trace numbers with a finger, count planets, color by number, solve mazes, and add and take away – one small screen at a time.

On screen or on paper

Every page comes from the Space Math workbook. Children can draw and color right on the screen, and grown-ups can print any page for pencil, crayons and the kitchen table.

What's inside

  • Numbers 0 to 10: trace each number and its word
  • Counting to 20 and to 100, before / after / between
  • Skip counting by 2s, 5s and 10s
  • More, less and equal
  • Addition, number bonds, make 10 and make 20
  • Subtraction and space story problems
  • Color by number, mazes and dot-to-dot
  • Daily Math Challenge, Moon badges, trophies and a Galaxy Map

Made for families

  • Try the first pages of every section free, then unlock the whole workbook with a monthly or yearly subscription – 2 weeks free for new subscribers
  • No ads and no accounts
  • No tracking – nothing about your child leaves the device
  • Parent area behind a grown-up question
  • Optional daily time limit
  • English, Spanish, French, Italian and German

Questions? See Support or read our Privacy policy.
